identity_limit: This quotient is the original analyzer's grouping, not an independently verified daemon boot; see gap-uptime-contract.json.

changes.assessment: Disables prewarm in dogfood config; also changes identity and sandbox configuration. This is a mitigation with confounding simultaneous changes, not the #2237 code repair.

Repairs checking-state probe recreation, checks worker liveness and adds a bounded idle-hold watchdog. A live worker rearms it; this is not a universal wall-clock cap on all prewarm work. Error fallback releases the gate for cold clones.
Debounces prewarm alerts for fifteen seconds, separating routine freshness checks from persistent holds.

Changes capacity-starved detection to avoid below-target ramp false alarms and decision-blocked demand. Earlier detection used free slots or low load with backlog; the topic does not identify prewarm as the unique cause.

interpretation: Repeated blocked/resolved signals do not by themselves prove the absorbing checking-state defect caused the entire classified interval. Capacity starvation, prewarm phase holds, load-ramp false alarms and dependency/decision blockage have distinct contracts. Merged source is not deployment evidence.
unresolved: Historical loaded revisions/effective prewarm exposure after the repair

reported_healthy_window.assessment: The interval begins at the disable-prewarm/config-change merge, almost two days before the code repair. Its low modeled gap total cannot be attributed uniquely to the later repair or prove non-recurrence.

category_interpretation: 257.2 h is pre-log aiur category d, or 90.91% of its 282.9167 h. All pre-log d is 273.0667 h of 316.0333 h (86.40%). These are different populations; neither isolates the absorbing-state defect. The analyzer assigns 'load governor' to every system.fleet.capacity.starved topic without reading its actual binding cause.

primary_diagnosis_records.assessment: Successful tool result includes an August 20 06:18:15.961183Z fleet-starvation alert with live agents zero, load 0.86/16.0, effective cap 1, configured cap 16 and binding prewarm checking; this directly contradicts interpreting the hard-coded load-governor label as its actual cause.
Successful tool result reports ready tickets 31, live agents 0, effective cap 1, configured cap 1 and prewarm checking. This verifies a snapshot, not the cause of every earlier model minute.
Assistant repeats the diagnosis; this is not independent evidence.
Assistant reports checking persists eight minutes after restarting with poll_seconds 30; reported intervention outcome, not proof of deployment across all later intervals.

after_code_merge_signals.interpretation: Later topic records exist; they neither prove recurrence of the same absorbing-state bug nor prove it absent. Effective configuration, loaded revision, queue eligibility and concrete constraint must be joined at each incident.
